items.author: Grayscale
items.context: Grayscale promociona el canje in-kind de criptos (incluye $BTC) por participaciones de sus ETF, con la frase "leave self-custody behind" y beneficios como asesores, soporte de portafolio y planificación patrimonial. Buen punto para debatir qué se gana y qué se entrega al pasar de autocustodia a un producto custodiado.
items.suggested_text: Swapping coins for ETF shares is a real trade-off, not just a convenience upgrade. You gain advisors and paperwork, but you go back to trusting a custodian, a broker and market hours with your $BTC. If self-custody feels hard, the fix can be learning to do it well. I wrote a book on building an air-gapped setup yourself: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: glassnode
items.context: Glassnode dice que Bitcoin cayó a $62K esta semana y que las pérdidas realizadas llegaron a niveles vistos solo cerca de mínimos de ciclos anteriores; enlaza su Week On-chain con más análisis (bloque de soporte de agosto, mapa de liquidaciones, oferta de stablecoins). Cifras según Glassnode.
items.suggested_text: Realized losses at cycle-low levels says a lot of coins just moved from weak hands to someone willing to hold. It doesn't mark the exact bottom, but it's the kind of data that matters more than the headline price. Curious how much of that came from short-term holders vs. older coins. $BTC

items.author: MicNguyenn105
items.context: Post sobre el heatmap de Glassnode: el precio de BTC volvió a entrar en la zona más densa de oferta de holders de corto plazo según su costo base, que según el autor suele actuar como imán de corto plazo. El texto llega truncado.
items.suggested_text: Price sitting on the short-term holder cost basis cluster is where conviction gets tested. If that band holds, a lot of recent buyers stay near breakeven; if it breaks, it can turn into overhead supply on the way back up. Worth watching how long $BTC spends inside it rather than the first touch.

items.author: martypartymusic
items.context: Marty Party afirma que quien tenga autocustodia de $BTC, $SOL, $SUI, $HYPE, $USDC o $USDT estará bien, igual que quien tenga oro físico, porque "lo que está fuera del sistema está a salvo"; habla de un "reset, no un crash" y menciona al FMI. El texto llega truncado; son afirmaciones del autor, no verificadas.
items.suggested_text: Self-custody removes exchange risk, but not every asset in that list is really outside the system. USDC and USDT can be frozen by their issuers even in your own wallet. With $BTC, once you hold your own keys, nobody can freeze it. That difference matters if the scenario you're worried about is a lockdown.

items.author: UpholdInc
items.context: Uphold promociona Vault Inheritance: designar un beneficiario para XRP, BTC y HBAR en pocos pasos, con control de fondos y saldo privado; describe Vault como "assisted" (el texto llega truncado). Abre el tema de la herencia de Bitcoin y de qué pasa si el proveedor no está.
items.suggested_text: Inheritance is the part of Bitcoin custody almost everyone leaves for later. The question I'd ask any plan: can my family recover the coins if the company behind it isn't around anymore? I put together how I think about doing it without depending on third parties here: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2119476332635586800
